fields.label: Product Type
fields.name: type
fields.instructions: Choose between Magazines, Articles, Books and Subscription Plans

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: subtitle
sub_fields.instructions: Enter an optional tagline or secondary title for the book.

sub_fields.label: Product ID
sub_fields.name: product_id
sub_fields.instructions: Reference only. Imported from the old CMS to preserve relationships. This field is not editable.

sub_fields.label: Publication month & year
sub_fields.name: publication_month_year
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the publication month and year (e.g., January 2024).

sub_fields.label: General Editors
sub_fields.name: general_editors
sub_fields.instructions: Select the general editors of this book from the People records.

sub_fields.label: Editors
sub_fields.name: editors
sub_fields.instructions: Select the editors who contributed to this book. Create any missing People records first.

sub_fields.label: Book Number
sub_fields.name: book_number
sub_fields.instructions: Imported from the old CMS for archival consistency. Leave blank if not applicable.

sub_fields.label: Create Print Variant
sub_fields.name: create_print_variant
sub_fields.instructions: Check to create a Print variation for this book. Uncheck if this book is only available digitally.

sub_fields.label: Create Digital Variant
sub_fields.name: create_digital_variant
sub_fields.instructions: Check to create a Digital variation for this book. Uncheck if this book is only available in print.

sub_fields.label: Print Details
sub_fields.name: print_details
sub_fields.instructions: Product data for the Print variation. These fields will automatically sync to the WooCommerce Print variation.

sub_fields.label: SKU
sub_fields.name: sku
sub_fields.instructions: Auto-generated from parent SKU. Format: {PARENT-SKU}-PRINT

sub_fields.label: ISBN
sub_fields.name: isbn
sub_fields.instructions: International Standard Book Number for print edition (e.g., 978-3-16-148410-0).

sub_fields.label: Stock Quantity
sub_fields.name: stock_quantity
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for unlimited stock

sub_fields.label: Out of Print
sub_fields.name: out_of_print
sub_fields.instructions: Mark this book as permanently out of print
sub_fields.message: This book is out of print

sub_fields.label: Digital Details
sub_fields.name: digital_details
sub_fields.instructions: Product data for the Digital variation. These fields will automatically sync to the WooCommerce Digital variation.

sub_fields.label: SKU
sub_fields.name: sku
sub_fields.instructions: Auto-generated from parent SKU. Format: {PARENT-SKU}-DIGITAL

sub_fields.label: ISBN
sub_fields.name: isbn
sub_fields.instructions: International Standard Book Number for digital edition (e.g., 978-3-16-148410-0).

sub_fields.label: Book PDF
sub_fields.name: pdf_file
sub_fields.instructions: Upload the PDF file for the digital version of this book. Customers will be able to download this file after purchase.

sub_fields.label: Open Access
sub_fields.name: open_access
sub_fields.instructions: Enable Open Access for this magazine. Linked Articles inherit this setting. The default is No.

sub_fields.label: Product ID
sub_fields.name: product_id
sub_fields.instructions: Reference only. Imported from the old CMS to preserve relationships. This field is not editable.

sub_fields.label: Year
sub_fields.name: year
sub_fields.instructions: Reference only. Imported from the legacy CMS. This field is not editable.

sub_fields.label: Publication month & year (Reference)
sub_fields.name: publication_month_year_reference
sub_fields.instructions: Reference only. Imported from the old CMS as reference.

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: subtitle_mag
sub_fields.instructions: Optional descriptive tagline or secondary title for the issue.

sub_fields.label: Volume Number
sub_fields.name: volume_number
sub_fields.instructions: Numeric value of the volume (e.g., 70).

sub_fields.label: Issue Number
sub_fields.name: issue_number
sub_fields.instructions: Numeric value of the issue within the volume (e.g., 3).

sub_fields.label: Publication month & year
sub_fields.name: publication_month_year
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the publication month and year in Start Date. For older issues spanning multiple months, also enter End Date. For the current issue, use Start Date only. End Date is optional and must be on or after Start Date.

sub_fields.label: Print Length
sub_fields.name: print_length
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the total number of pages in the magazine.

sub_fields.label: Open Access Featured Text
sub_fields.name: open_access_featured_text
sub_fields.instructions: Enter annotation text for this publication's listing on the Open Access page.

sub_fields.label: Sightseeing Scan
sub_fields.name: sightseeing_scan
sub_fields.instructions: Upload a scan of this magazine's sightseeing page.

sub_fields.label: General Editor(s)
sub_fields.name: editors
sub_fields.instructions: Select the general editor(s) of this issue (from dropdown list).

sub_fields.label: Guest Editor(s)
sub_fields.name: guest_editors
sub_fields.instructions: Select/add guest editor(s) who contributed to the issue.

sub_fields.label: Print Details
sub_fields.name: print_details
sub_fields.instructions: Product data for the Print variation. These fields will automatically sync to the WooCommerce Print variation.

sub_fields.label: SKU
sub_fields.name: sku
sub_fields.instructions: Auto-generated from parent SKU. Format: {PARENT-SKU}-PRINT

sub_fields.label: ISSN
sub_fields.name: issn
sub_fields.instructions: Pre-filled from Global Settings. Can be overridden if this issue has a different ISSN.

sub_fields.label: Stock Quantity
sub_fields.name: stock_quantity
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for unlimited stock

sub_fields.label: Out of Print
sub_fields.name: out_of_print
sub_fields.instructions: Mark this issue as permanently out of print
sub_fields.message: This issue is out of print

sub_fields.label: Digital Details
sub_fields.name: digital_details
sub_fields.instructions: Product data for the Digital variation. These fields will automatically sync to the WooCommerce Digital variation.

sub_fields.label: SKU
sub_fields.name: sku
sub_fields.instructions: Auto-generated from parent SKU. Format: {PARENT-SKU}-DIGITAL

sub_fields.label: ISSN
sub_fields.name: issn
sub_fields.instructions: Pre-filled from Global Settings. Can be overridden if this issue has a different ISSN.

sub_fields.label: Magazine PDF
sub_fields.name: pdf_file
sub_fields.instructions: Upload the PDF file for the digital version of this magazine issue. Customers will be able to download this file after purchase.

sub_fields.label: Open Access
sub_fields.name: open_access
sub_fields.instructions: Auto-inherited from parent Magazine. Automatically updates when parent Magazine's Open Access setting changes.

sub_fields.label: Parent Publication
sub_fields.name: parent_publication
sub_fields.instructions: Select the parent Magazine for this Article. Each Article can only have one parent Magazine.

sub_fields.label: DOI Link
sub_fields.name: doi_link
sub_fields.instructions: Read-only URL for the Crossref DOI, populated separately by import or integration. Saving this Article does not request a DOI.

sub_fields.label: From
sub_fields.name: page_from
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the first page as a positive whole number. Fill both From and To, or leave both blank.

sub_fields.label: To
sub_fields.name: page_to
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the last page as a positive whole number, at least equal to From. For a single-page article, use the same number in both fields.

sub_fields.label: Authors
sub_fields.name: authors
sub_fields.instructions: Select the authors of this article from the People records.

sub_fields.label: Product Data
sub_fields.name: product_data
sub_fields.instructions: Configure WooCommerce product data for this article. These fields will automatically sync to WooCommerce when you save the product.

sub_fields.label: SKU
sub_fields.name: sku
sub_fields.instructions: Product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit). Auto-generated as ARTICLE-{ID}.

sub_fields.label: Regular Price (INR)
sub_fields.name: regular_price_inr
sub_fields.instructions: Regular price in Indian Rupees.

sub_fields.label: Sale Price (INR)
sub_fields.name: sale_price_inr
sub_fields.instructions: Sale price in Indian Rupees (optional).

sub_fields.label: Regular Price (USD)
sub_fields.name: regular_price_usd
sub_fields.instructions: Regular price in US Dollars (for international customers).

sub_fields.label: Sale Price (USD)
sub_fields.name: sale_price_usd
sub_fields.instructions: Sale price in US Dollars (optional).

sub_fields.label: Article PDF
sub_fields.name: pdf_file
sub_fields.instructions: Upload the PDF file for this article.

fields.label: Taxonomies
fields.name: taxonomies
fields.instructions: For Magazines: Auto-inherited from linked Articles (read-only). For Books & Articles: Select manually.

sub_fields.label: Time periods
sub_fields.name: time_periods
sub_fields.instructions: Choose from the predefined list; new periods only added sparingly by admins.

sub_fields.label: Subjects
sub_fields.name: subjects
sub_fields.instructions: Choose from the predefined list; new subjects only added sparingly by admins.

sub_fields.label: Geography
sub_fields.name: geography
sub_fields.instructions: Select from the list of countries (global). For India, you can add more granular tags (e.g., Meghalaya, Tanjore).

sub_fields.label: Tags
sub_fields.name: tags
sub_fields.instructions: Add tags to the product. Tags are used to categorize the product.
